rows.quote: This investigation harnessed the unparalleled breadth of plasma protein and KSD pooled genome-wide association study (GWAS) data, sourced from the United Kingdom Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project (UKBPPP) and the FinnGen database version R10.
rows.coder_note: Sentence states the outcome GWAS data were sourced from the FinnGen database version R10.
